lede: The week's meeting to watch is the Gondola Leadership Committee on July 28, where the agenda flags an action item on background and history alongside a deep dive into the Capital Investment Grant program and funding commitments — real money and long-term decisions are on the table. Town Council also convenes Monday as the Liquor Licensing Authority for a public hearing on KOTO Radio's Live at the Drive permit for July 30. On the community side, Shakespeare in the Park wraps its Henry V run this weekend and Town Talk takes on climate and energy Tuesday.
